softbody_diff_phd_cantilever.caption: Two fresh forward simulations on the original 756-node, 500-cell Hex8 cantilever: the released axial benchmark (25 steps at dt=0.01 s), then a 30-degree twist release (100 steps at dt=0.001 s). The twist initial angle is an explicit example setting, not recovered from the paper. Mesh edges and tip angle show the rotation. Slow-motion playback at 24 fps includes held initial and final poses; holds do not advance physics.

softbody_diff_phd_ur5_poke.caption: Current forward-only simulation with the original penalty contact and root-prescribed probe, overlaid with the recorded blue surface. Includes the initial state and all 35 prescribed-motion frames (1,050 physics substeps, dt=1/900 s). No fitted checkpoint or training. Deep probe penetration remains unresolved; this clip shows the limitation and is not a successful contact validation. Requires private prepared PokeFlex data. Slow-motion playback at 15 fps includes held initial and final poses.
softbody_diff_phd_ur5_poke.label: White: simulation | blue: recording | penetration unresolved
